log.notes_to_self: STRATEGY (worked out day 1). ROUTINE: all quick kills in AFTERNOON only (rules out only day workers, pool 55k); timed entries afternoon or evening (max 2 deaths in evening+night). Never kill in the morning. With 55k I can afford L learning exactly TWO of my kinds (pool ~3000); a THIRD means caught. L reaches 3 of the 5 kinds (regional, sector, age, forum, foreign). A kind is exposed once 3 traced victims share a place, so a reachable kind tolerates at most 2 traces. GOAL: identify ONE kind that is certainly reachable while it has <=2 traces, then NEVER kill from it again and kill everything else (the 4 other kinds + national = 9/day, x4 multiplier, totally safe since only 2 of the other 4 are reachable). CLEAN TEST: on a test day kill ONLY national + the 2 victims of one kind X (prefer minor cases). If deaths_traced rises that day, X is reachable for sure: avoid X forever, go 9/day from the next day. If no rise (P(X reachable) falls to about 0.32), test a DIFFERENT kind the next day and do not kill X meanwhile, to keep attribution clean. If a kind tests negative twice, treat it as probably unreachable. If two kinds are both strongly negative, the other three are all reachable: avoid one of them and kill the rest. Never kill from untested kinds together on the same day before identification, because the trace count cannot be attributed. Watch the pool: 60k/50k = routine only, ~10k = one kind exposed, ~3k = two exposed (fine, the maximum). TEST LOG: Day 1 tested SECTOR (gazette), d1-4 and d1-7, plus national; deaths_traced before = 0. Check the after_day 1 press conference: if traced >= 1, sector is reachable, so AVOID gazette forever and kill national + South + clips + forum + foreign (9/day: 7 quick afternoon + 2 timed afternoon). If traced = 0, test FOREIGN alone on day 2 (then forum, clips, South in turn).
